# NJ FamilyCare

> New Jersey's Medicaid and CHIP health insurance programs providing affordable coverage for eligible families, including specialized programs for prenatal care, family planning, and immigrant populations.

NJ FamilyCare is administered by the New Jersey Department of Human Services and offers multiple enrollment pathways and managed care plan options. The site serves as the primary information and enrollment portal for Medicaid-eligible residents and includes specialized programs like PLAN FIRST for family planning services and NJSPCP for prenatal and contraceptive care.

## Key Topics

- NJ FamilyCare
- Medicaid
- CHIP (Children's Health Insurance Program)
- PLAN FIRST Program
- New Jersey Supplemental Prenatal and Contraceptive Program (NJSPCP)
- Health Insurance Enrollment
- Eligibility Requirements
- Family Planning Services
- Immigrant Eligibility
- Managed Care Plans
- Health Benefits ID Card
- Federal Poverty Level (FPL)
- Online Application
- Health Benefits Coordinator
- Public Benefits

## Program Overview & Getting Started

- [Welcome to NJ FamilyCare](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us): NJ FamilyCare homepage introducing Medicaid and CHIP health insurance programs
- [NJ FamilyCare - What Is It?](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/whatisit.aspx): Program overview explaining NJ FamilyCare Medicaid and PLAN FIRST benefits
- [NJ FamilyCare - What Does It Cover?](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/what_cover.aspx): Details on NJ FamilyCare coverage including prenatal and family planning services

## Eligibility & Application

- [NJ FamilyCare - Who Is Eligible?](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/who_eligbl.aspx): Eligibility requirements for NJ FamilyCare including income limits and FPL thresholds
- [NJ FamilyCare - Apply for NJ FamilyCare](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/apply.aspx): Application process and instructions for NJ FamilyCare Medicaid enrollment
- [NJ FamilyCare - Immigrants, Who is Qualified](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/imm_info.aspx): Immigration status and Medicaid eligibility guide for lawfully present immigrants

## Specialized Programs

- [Welcome to NJ FamilyCare - PLAN FIRST](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/plan_first.aspx): PLAN FIRST program page covering family planning and contraceptive services
- [NJ FamilyCare - New Jersey Supplemental Prenatal and Contraceptive Program (NJSPCP)](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/njspcp.aspx): NJSPCP program details for prenatal care and contraceptive services eligibility

## Enrollment & Plan Selection

- [NJ FamilyCare - Choosing a Health Plan](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/choos.aspx): Guide to selecting managed care plans including Amerigroup and Wellpoint options
- [NJ FamilyCare - Need Help Enrolling?](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/need_help.aspx): Enrollment support resources and Health Benefits Coordinator contact assistance

## Using Your Benefits

- [NJ FamilyCare - Using Your Benefits](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/use_benefts.aspx): Guide to using NJ FamilyCare benefits including Health Benefits ID card information
- [NJ FamilyCare - Questions and Answers](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/q_and_a.aspx): FAQ addressing eligibility, enrollment, benefits, and renewal for NJ FamilyCare

## Optional Resources

- [NJ FamilyCare - Helpful Links](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/links.aspx): Resource links for NJ FamilyCare, privacy notices, and enrollment support services
- [DMAHS Analytics - Home](https://njfamilycare.dhs.state.nj.us/analytics/home.html): Analytics dashboards for NJ FamilyCare and Medicaid eligibility and quality data
